guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the initial stage with the error: "failed to resolve reference 'docker.io/continuumio/miniconda3:23.11.1-1': docker.io/continuumio/miniconda3:23.11.1-1: not found". This indicates that the specified Docker image tag '23.11.1-1' for 'continuumio/miniconda3' does not exist or is incorrect in Docker Hub. To fix this, verify the available tags for the 'continuumio/miniconda3' image on Docker Hub (https://hub.docker.com/r/continuumio/miniconda3/tags) and replace '23.11.1-1' with a valid and existing tag, e.g., '23.3.1-0' or simply use the latest stable tag. Ensure that the base image line starts simply with 'FROM continuumio/miniconda3:<tag>' without the '--platform=linux/x86_64' flag if that causes compatibility issues. After correcting the base image tag, retry the Docker build.
